items.html: And let us return to explain the matter of the Panim [face] and Achoraim [back] of Yeshsut and Tevuna. Behold, their Panim is the squared HaVaYaH of Yudin, which totals 184 in Gematria, and this is the Panim of Yeshsut. And the squared AHYH totals 544, and this is the Panim of Tevuna. Therefore the Panim of Yeshsut totals 184 in Gematria, to hint that through this, which is his Panim, he couples with Tevuna and "visits" (Poked) her. And it also totals "from before" (Mikedem), to show that what this name was above in Aba in the discernment of Achor, here, in the Panim of Yeshsut, is called Kedem, in the secret of "You formed me behind and before."
